response.justification: Bogdan far exceeds the 6+ years requirement with ~15 years of hands-on fullstack work spanning web, mobile, desktop and embedded systems, and his recent roles map closely to the stack: TypeScript/Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS CDK, Docker/Kubernetes and Git. His current role explicitly includes AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators, which directly matches the AI agent development requirement — a differentiator few candidates will have. He also brings unusually deep testing credibility (authored a D test runner and assertion library, taught Selenium/TDD courses, practiced TDD/CI/CD/trunk-based development), plus a CS degree and strong communication signals from public talks and workshops. Gaps are mostly framework-specific (no Nest.js or Vitest/Jest named, light Kotlin/Java and PostgreSQL exposure) and are reasonably learnable for an engineer of this breadth. Worth interviewing, with technical probing on Nest.js, React depth, and relational data modeling.
strengths: 15+ years fullstack; strong TypeScript/Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS, Docker/K8s
Direct AI-agent and MCP tooling experience matching a hard-to-find requirement
Exceptional testing/craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, authored test frameworks)
concerns: No explicit Nest.js, Vitest or Jest experience listed
Kotlin/Java exposure appears dated and limited (robotic arms, 2016-2018)
Relational DB depth unclear; recent data work is MongoDB-centric

key_factors.factor: Core stack depth and years of experience
Missing Nest.js and named testing frameworks
